title: Dynamic Response of a Finite Circular Plate on an Elastic Half-Space Using the Truncated Lamb Kernel
summary: We develop an exact operator formulation for the dynamic interaction between a finite circular elastic plate and an elastic half-space. Classical analyses, beginning with Lamb's representation of the half-space response, typically assume an infinite plate and rely on diagonalization of the soil operator via the continuous Hankel transform. For a plate of finite radius $R$, however, both traction and displacement are supported only on $0 \le r \le R$, leading to the spatially truncated Lamb operator \[ \mathscr{M}(ω) = χ_{[0,R]} \, T(ω)\, χ_{[0,R]}, \] where $T(ω)$ is the Hankel multiplier…
